description: Header file defining functions and data structures for requantization in quantized neural network operations, including parameter computations and quantization routines for different architectures.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_scalar_requantization_params
methods.description: Computes requantization parameters for scalar 32-bit integer output based on scale, zero point, min, and max.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_scalar_fp32_requantization_params
methods.description: Computes requantization parameters for floating-point scales, zero point, min, and max.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_requantization_params
methods.description: Computes requantization parameters for a given scale, zero point, min, and max, with architecture-specific implementations.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_conv_quantization_params
methods.description: Computes convolution quantization parameters including zero points and scales for input, kernel, and output.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_avgpool_quantization_params
methods.description: Computes average pooling quantization parameters including bias, scale, zero point, min, and max.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_scalar_avgpool_quantization_params
methods.description: Computes scalar average pooling quantization parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_u8_clamping_params
methods.description: Computes clamping parameters for uint8 output range.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_add_quantization_params
methods.description: Computes parameters for quantized addition of two tensors.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_compute_scalar_add_quantization_params
methods.description: Computes scalar parameters for quantized addition.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_q31_requantize
methods.description: Requantizes a 32-bit integer to uint8 using precomputed parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_fp32_requantize
methods.description: Requantizes a 32-bit integer to uint8 using floating-point parameters for a specific output channel.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_fp32_requantize_magic
methods.description: Requantizes a 32-bit integer to uint8 using a 'magic' floating-point method for efficiency.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_avgpool_quantize
methods.description: Quantizes an integer value for average pooling output.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_add_quantize
methods.description: Quantizes the sum of two uint8 values based on precomputed addition parameters.
